Patiño Webb succeeds Ben Goodwin, founder and CEO, who is transitioning to executive chairman and head of innovation for the company. [...] Goodwin, who founded the company in 2018 to support digestive health, will focus on the company’s long-term vision, advance innovation and also shape its next phase of growth while also stewarding its mission, values and culture and will work in partnership with Patiño Webb. Patiño Webb comes to Olipop from Electrolit, where he most recently was CEO. During his career, Patiño Webb also has worked for Procter & Gamble, Johnson & Johnson, Red Bull and Unilever. Chief Executive Officer Ben Goodwin will step aside next week and pass the helm of the high-fiber, low-sugar soda maker to an industry veteran from the hydration-beverage brand Electrolit. Christian Patiño Webb, who has been CEO of Electrolit since 2022, will take over on Aug. 17, according to Goodwin, Olipop’s cofounder. He said he’ll stay on as executive chairman of the board and head of innovation as the company scouts for new markets outside the US.
